name: dev-kit
description: Spec-driven development, end to end. The spec settles what to build, the plan settles how: spec → plan → isolated worktree → one TDD round per task, each commit reviewed by a subagent that did not write it → wrap-up review over the whole branch → a verification report you can reproduce. Plus init, for AGENTS.md, layered docs and lint guardrails wired into CI.
